_comment: Of the poles, and the first word written to be felt differently laid bare than aimed (`unaimed`, the
readings spike, 2026-09-30). It claims two things -- a cold temperature and a polar path, a circle held
just over the horizon -- and attachment decides which lands: `polar climate` the cold, `polar sun` and
`polar moon` the path. Laid bare, the sun and the moon each feel it one Age in four, so a polar Age is
always cold, leans to the frozen biomes, may have an aurora, and now and then has a polar sun: the
Lean on purpose. A word that narrows is charged for every part it reaches, so the snow, the stars and
the pale vault `frozen` offers are left to `frozen`.
